description: This file defines data classes and functions related to various function signatures in the PyTorch code generation framework, including C++ signatures, dispatcher signatures, native signatures, and view inverse signatures. It primarily serves as a type and signature description module within the code generation pipeline.

classes.name: CppSignature
classes.description: Represents a single overload of a C++ API function schema, including various properties such as method status, fidelity, and symint support.

classes.name: CppSignatureGroup
classes.description: Groups multiple CppSignature instances related to a single FunctionSchema, including faithful and symint variants, and provides methods to access them.

classes.name: DispatcherSignature
classes.description: Represents a function signature in the dispatcher API, supporting argument reflection, name generation, and type specification.

classes.name: NativeSignature
classes.description: Encapsulates the signature of a native function, including arguments, declaration, and defn generation, and supports dispatcher expression translation.

classes.name: ViewInverseSignature
classes.description: Represents the signature for a view inverse function in the functionalization group, including name and declaration.

classes.name: StructuredImplSignature
classes.description: Represents a structured implementation signature, associated with a group and a name, mainly for codegen purposes.

methods.name: Sequence[Binding] arguments(self)
methods.description: Returns the sequence of arguments for the signature, often formatted as a list of bindings or parameters.

methods.name: str name(self)
methods.description: Generates or returns the name of the signature or function, with options to suppress suffixes.

methods.name: str decl( self, *, name: str | None = None, prefix: str = "", is_redispatching_fn: bool = False, suppress_symint_suffix: bool = False, )
methods.description: Returns the C++ declaration string for the signature.

methods.name: str defn( self, *, name: str | None = None, prefix: str = "", is_redispatching_fn: bool = False, )
methods.description: Returns the C++ function definition string (declaration plus optional body).

methods.name: str ptr_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the function pointer type representation of the signature.

methods.name: str type(self)
methods.description: Returns the full C++ function type as a string.

methods.name: CppSignature most_faithful_signature(self)
methods.description: In CppSignatureGroup, yields the most faithful (accurate/descriptive) signature available.

methods.name: Iterator[CppSignature] signatures(self, *, symint: bool = True)
methods.description: In CppSignatureGroup, yields all related signatures, optionally including symint variants.

methods.name: CppSignatureGroup from_native_function( f: NativeFunction, *, method: bool, fallback_binding: bool = False )
methods.description: Creates a CppSignatureGroup from a NativeFunction, method flag, and fallback option.

methods.name: DispatcherSignature from_schema( func: FunctionSchema, *, prefix: str = "", symint: bool = True )
methods.description: Creates a DispatcherSignature instance from a FunctionSchema, with optional prefix and symint support.

methods.name: list[Binding] arguments(self)
methods.description: In DispatcherSignature, returns argument list for the dispatcher API.

methods.name: str name(self, *, suppress_symint_suffix: bool = False)
methods.description: Constructs the signature name, possibly with a prefix.

methods.name: str decl(self)

methods.name: str defn( self, name: str | None = None, *, is_redispatching_fn: bool = False )

methods.name: list[Expr] exprs(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of Expr objects representing arguments.

methods.name: CType returns_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the CType representing the return type of the signature.
